# ffxf_databases (Data Source)

Reads FFXF Cloud database API data. Database features are in beta; accounts without access receive HTTP 403.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ffxf_databases" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `databases_json` (String) JSON array of databases returned by the API; use jsondecode to access its fields.
- `quota` (Number) Maximum number of databases available to this account.
